answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16081 Country: India Title: Aslamualikum: we some of my friends decided to pray TRAWEE in one of my friend's home but we did not get hafiz. can I pray with seeing the Quran? Question: Aslamualikum: we some of my friends decided to pray TRAWEE in one of my friend's home but we did not get hafiz. can I pray with seeing the Quran? Answer ID: 16081 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1745/D=252/K=1430) According to Hanafi Fiqh, the salah turns invalid if the Quran was recited by seeing; therefore you should not perform tarawih by seeing in the Quran, you should perform it with small chapters like Surah al-Fil etc which you remember by heart. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
